results.text:
Voyager 1 just became the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth (~16.1 billion miles / 25.9 billion km). 

But on November 14 it stopped sending science and engineering data – only an empty carrier signal is still coming through. 

The transmitter and pointing system are working; NASA suspects another onboard computer glitch (similar to 2023).

Only two of its ten instruments remain on (magnetometer and plasma wave detector). The probe has already lasted more than 10× longer than planned. Commands take a full day each way, so fixing it will be slow. 

Fingers crossed. 🚀
